message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The only legal moves with unvisited neighbors are decrease_precision (2) and change_interpolation (1). The evaluated LUT linear points show a clear precision/area tradeoff: phase_bits 16 gives SQNR 82.1 dB at 1584.6 um^2, phase_bits 14 gives 72.8 dB at 1346.5 um^2, and phase_bits 12 gives 61.0 dB at 1185.8 um^2. Decreasing precision from the current high-precision point should recover area while still keeping SQNR well above the 61 dB low-precision case, making it the best balance among available legal actions."}
